name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Limited
summary: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Limited manufactures and markets consumer electrical products in India. It operates in two segments, Electrical Consumer Durables and Lighting Products. The company offers fans, such as ceiling, table, wall-mounted, pedestal, ventilating, kitchen tower, exhaust, and industrial fans; and agriculture, industrial monoset, residential, compressor, specialty, and solar pumps.
